content:
maya: Hey team — prepping a POC with Acme Corp. They require HSM-backed customer-managed keys (BYOK) + automatic 90-day rotation and provable key zeroization. Need: (1) POC plan, (2) pricing delta, (3) canned answers for their security questionnaire. Who can own?
sam: I can own the technical side. Quick q: are they on commercial AWS/GCP or a gov cloud? Rotation options differ slightly.
maya: Commercial (us-east-1). They want FIPS attestation and a short demo showing rotation + audit evidence.
sam: Ok. High level: we can do AWS KMS EKM flow or a customer HSM gateway for Private. Envelope encryption in our runtime — Redwood never stores plaintext master keys. Rotation is handled by key versioning and KV-cache invalidation; we also emit audit events when we drop caches.
sam: Example config for the POC connector (will put in runbook):
```bash
REDWOOD_KMS_PROVIDER=aws
REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ARN=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
KMS_ROTATION_SCHEDULE=90d
REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT=https://ekm.example.com
```
maya: Nice. What's the impact on price and latency so I can update procurement?
carla: Ballpark for Private/Dedicated + BYOK/HSM: one-time onboarding eng fee $8,000, monthly HSM connector license $1,200, plus a small per-token/compute surcharge we usually quote as ~5% for envelope overhead. Exact numbers to be confirmed in the quote. :money_with_wings:
sam: Also call out expected latency bump ~5-15ms p50 depending on KMS network hops. For high-throughput customers we recommend enabling local KV-caching + prefetching and/or putting KMS in same VPC.
jordan: For the security questionnaire — here's a paste-ready summary we should include in their doc: 
- Key ownership: Customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported; keys remain under customer KMS/HSM control.
- Key material: Redwood never has access to plaintext master keys; we use envelope encryption and ephemeral data keys.
- HSM attestation: We support integrations with FIPS 140-2/3 validated HSMs (AWS CloudHSM, external HSM gateways) and can provide certs upon request.
- Rotation: Keys are rotated via KMS key versions; rotation event produces CloudTrail + Redwood audit log entries. We can supply exports/screenshots of rotation events.
- Zeroization: On key deletion, customer KMS/HSM zeroizes per its process; Redwood will purge cached key versions and log the purge.
- Access controls: RBAC, separation of duties, and least-privilege on the KMS connector.
- Logging & retention: All key use is logged (CloudTrail + Redwood audit trail); retention configurable per customer.
- Attestation artifacts: We can attach HSM cert and a signed statement of integration when needed.
jordan: Also add: we do not replicate customer key material to multi-region unless customer requests cross-region replication of KMS/replica keys.
maya: They also want a screenshot/proof after rotation showing key id change and access logs. How fast can we produce that for the POC?
sam: I can script a rotate-demo: call KMS RotateKey, then export CloudTrail filtered events and Redwood audit entries. Should be a 15–30 min demo run. I'll include script.
sam: Sample demo rotation script (very small):
```bash
# rotate key version
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id abcd-1234 --pending-window-in-days 7
# show associated CloudTrail events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...
```
carla: I'll draft SOW contract language for BYOK/HSM appendix and pricing line items, then send to maya for review. Need final numbers from bizops.
deploy-bot: POC cluster redwood-poc-acme-2026 created in us-east-1; test creds pushed to 1Password (item: redwood/poc/acme).
maya: Great — customer legal also asked about SLA/attestation to FIPS cert. jordan, can you add the attestation cert and short blurb for the legal team?
jordan: Yes — I'll attach the FIPS cert pdf (from AWS/FIPS bundle) and a 2-sentence attestation paragraph. Need to confirm exact HSM model; will follow up.
maya: Can we have a technical runbook + rotation demo steps + canned questionnaire answers by EOD Friday? That’s our ask to close the POC this week.
sam: I'll have runbook + demo scripts by Friday EOD.
jordan: I'll have questionnaire answers + attestation text by Friday.
carla: I'll finalize draft SOW and a provisional quote by Friday midday.
maya: Thanks all. Ping me when draft SOW + runbook are ready. :thumbsup:
